verdict.summary_en: Supplier delivery note (送货单) SN-261014-585 dated 2026/10/14 from Guangzhou PackRight Packaging Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, against PO 4500318738. One line: PR-SL-0604 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 (USK/PE, 64,000 PCS in 12 packages, gross weight 168 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. The remarks field is empty. The document carries the supplier's red round shipping seal and a handwritten receiver signature 'Yilmaz D.' with no date.
observations: Red circular supplier seal 'GUANGZHOU PACKRIGHT PACKAGING CO LTD' with 出货专用章 (special shipping seal) overlaps the unit cell (PCS) and the header; the seal contains no date or number. The seal ink is slightly smudged but the quantity and unit are still readable.
Item description is cut off: it reads 'Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 (USK/PE' with no closing parenthesis.
Handwritten signature 'Yilmaz D.' sits on the receiver-signature line; there is no receiving date, receiving stamp or received quantity.
Package count of 12 appears in both the table and the footer and they agree.
A barcode at the top right was not decoded.
